Project-authored synthetic read-only preview fixtures. No user data, credentials, external resources or executable macros. XLS is BIFF8/OLE written by xlwt 1.3.0 (fixture generation only); XLSM is a macro-enabled OOXML container without VBA, derived from the existing synthetic Office sample. Draw.io includes two uncompressed pages; DIO contains their URI-encoded raw-DEFLATE representation. CSV/TSV exercise Chinese text, quoted separators/newlines, leading zeros and a formula-looking literal. Excalidraw and Mermaid are original minimal scenes.
